name: realtime.openvibe.network
tagline: Closed: realtime delivery is part of OpenVibe.Events.
description: OpenVibe.Realtime was planned as a separate service for live updates in the browser. Decision record ADR-005 (accepted 2026-09-22) closed it: browser realtime is part of OpenVibe.Events, as server-sent events with cursor resume at openvibe.events/realtime/stream. This address serves only this notice.
keywords: openvibe realtime, openvibe events, server-sent events

relationships.linksLead: Realtime delivery for browsers is a part of OpenVibe.Events; the decision and its record are public.

links.label: OpenVibe.Events
links.note: Durable events, subscriptions and signed delivery; browsers subscribe at /realtime/stream.
